items.title_zh: 影石正布局 AI 眼镜，或采用“分体电池”设计
items.title_en: Insta360 Moves Into AI Glasses, Possibly With a Split-Battery Design
items.summary_zh: 9 月 25 日中午消息，有接近影石创新人士透露， 当前影石创新正在布局 AI 眼镜赛道 ，并在进行相关研发，未来或将推出自己的 AI 眼镜产品。 此前，影石创新获得了一项名为“可穿戴式眼镜”的实用新型专利授权。专利摘要显示，该眼镜主体佩戴于头部，电池装置与眼镜主体分离、佩戴于身体其他部位，通过电连接线供电，目的是“减轻用户头部负重，降低长时间佩戴的压力”。这一“分体电池”设计思路，与当前主流 AI 眼镜将电池塞入镜腿的方案明显不同，更接近长时间佩戴拍摄的工程取向。
items.summary_en: Insta360 is reportedly developing AI glasses, and a recently granted utility patent describes eyewear with a body-mounted battery connected by cable to reduce head weight. The split-battery approach differs from mainstream AI glasses that put batteries in the temples, suggesting an engineering focus on long-duration wear and capture.
items.why_zh: 以全景相机见长的影石入局，可能以拍摄能力与续航为差异化切入点，加剧 AI 眼镜市场竞争。
items.why_en: Insta360's entry could differentiate on capture capability and battery life, intensifying competition in the AI glasses market.

items.title_zh: 预测智能体何时该推理？面向可靠性路由的行为压力测试
items.title_en: When Should Forecasting Agents Reason? Behavioral Stress Tests for Reliability Routing
items.summary_zh: 该研究在 ForecastBench 风格的二元预测任务上，把“是否检索、是否推理、是否采信市场先验、是否使用历史类比”当作可观测的智能体行为，而非隐藏的实现细节。其核心发现是机制选择依赖于数据来源：对某些数据生成过程，结构化历史类比明显占优，而市场类机制在另一些情形下的表现则另有不同（原文摘要在此处截断）。研究据此主张通过行为压力测试为不同情形路由更合适的预测机制，从而提升预测智能体的可靠性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28475v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Forecasting agents increasingly combine language-model reasoning, retrieval, ensembling, and calibration, but it remains unclear when each behavior should be trusted. We study this question on ForecastBench-style binary forecasting tasks, treating the choice to retrieve, reason, defer to a market prior, or use a historical analog as an observable agent behavior rather than a hidden implementation detail. Our central finding is that mechanism choice is source-dependent: structured analogs dominate for some data-generating processes, while market/c…
items.why_zh: 它把“何时推理”变成可测量、可路由的工程问题，有助于预测智能体在简单机制更可靠时避免过度自信。
items.why_en: It turns "when to reason" into a measurable routing problem, helping forecasting agents avoid overconfidence where a simpler mechanism works better.

items.title_zh: TW3Cast：仅凭训练集选型的冻结路由与轻调基础模型，跻身 GIFT-Eval 前三
items.title_en: TW3Cast: A Frozen Router of Lightly Fine-Tuned Foundation Models for Time-Series Forecasting on GIFT-Eval, Selected Entirely on the Training Split
items.summary_zh: TW3Cast 是一个时间序列预测系统，截至 2026 年 9 月 14 日，在 GIFT-Eval 基准上以平均 MASE 排名位列 130 个参赛条目的第 3 名。排在其前面的两个条目属于榜单的“智能体”类别，即使用智能体或语言模型进行推理、生成或选择预测的多步系统，而 TW3Cast 不使用任何智能体或语言模型。它的路由是一张在训练集上一次性计算后即被冻结的表，其专家模型则是在这些训练集上做过轻量微调的公开基础模型（摘要提到 97 个数据集/任务，此处原文截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28506v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: TW3Cast is a time-series forecasting system that reaches position 3 of 130 entries on the GIFT-Eval benchmark by mean MASE rank, as of 2026-09-14. The two entries above it belong to the leaderboard's agentic category, multi-step systems that use agents or language models to reason about, generate or select forecasts. TW3Cast runs no agent and no language model. Its selection is a table computed once on the training split and then frozen, and its experts are public foundation models lightly fine-tuned on those training splits. For each of the 97 d…
items.why_zh: 它表明不依赖智能体或大模型的简单冻结路由方案，也能在时间序列预测榜单上逼近智能体系统。
items.why_en: It shows a simple frozen-routing approach without agents or LLMs can come close to agentic systems on time-series forecasting.

items.title_zh: DEEPO：面向多模态大模型幻觉的双熵增强策略优化
items.title_en: DEEPO: Dual-Entropy Enhanced Policy Optimization for Hallucination in MLLMs
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，强化学习虽被广泛用于提升多模态大模型（MLLM）的推理能力，但其对幻觉的影响并不稳定，根源在于“从奖励到参数更新”的纠正链条上存在两处薄弱环节。在采样（rollout）层面，高语义熵的困难问题经常产生整组全错的样本，使组相对优势恰好退化为零，而这正是幻觉风险最高之处；在优化层面，模型“自信但错误”的 token 对梯度不可见。DEEPO 提出双熵增强的策略优化方法，针对这两点进行改进以抑制幻觉。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28570v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used to sharpen reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet its effect on hallucination is uneven. We trace this to two weak points in the \emph{correction chain} from reward to parameter update. At the rollout level, hard queries---those with high semantic entropy---frequently produce unanimously wrong sample groups, collapsing the group-relative advantage to zero exactly where hallucination risk is highest. At the optimization level, confident-but-wrong tokens are gradient-invisible: a catego…
items.why_zh: 它直指强化学习训练中幻觉最难被纠正的两处机制性缺口，为降低多模态模型幻觉提供新思路。
items.why_en: It pinpoints two structural gaps where RL fails to correct hallucinations, offering a new route to reducing them in MLLMs.

items.title_zh: TWIST：面向对话记忆“干预质量”的基准，附人工验证的草稿对齐
items.title_en: TWIST: A Proposed Benchmark for Intervention Quality in Conversational Memory, with a Human-Validated Draft-Alignment
items.summary_zh: 现有长对话记忆基准多聚焦于召回与提示式知识更新，近期工作也开始研究用户信念的演化与记忆状态。TWIST 提出一套新的基准，用于衡量一个此前未被测量的属性——“干预质量”，即一个已部署的记忆系统通过自身的写入、召回与审核接口，能否在信念变化的节点上正确行动。该基准包含四条赛道，覆盖无提示的张力检测、依据记录审核即将发出的草稿、以当前信念作答同时保留被取代的历史等场景。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28575v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-conversation memory benchmarks increasingly test recall and prompted knowledge updates, and recent work studies evolving user beliefs and memory state. TWIST is a proposed benchmark suite for a complementary, unmeasured property: intervention quality -- whether a deployed memory system, exercised through its own ingest/recall/vet surface, acts correctly at belief change points. Four tracks cover unprompted tension detection, vetting outgoing drafts against the record, answering with current beliefs while preserving supersession history, and…
items.why_zh: 它把“记忆系统何时该主动干预”变成可评估的指标，补齐了长期对话记忆评测中的一块空白。
items.why_en: It turns "when a memory system should intervene" into a measurable metric, filling a gap in long-term conversational memory evaluation.

items.title_zh: 用 AI 智能体驱动流行病模型：Epydemix Agent 框架
items.title_en: Driving Epidemic Models with AI Agents: the Epydemix Agent Framework
items.summary_zh: 研究者提出 Epydemix Agent Framework，这是叠加在开源 Python 库 Epydemix（用于随机分室流行病建模）之上的附加层，目的是让基于大语言模型的 AI 智能体能够更可靠地操作该建模工具。框架为 Epydemix 增加了四项面向智能体交互的能力，包括发现可用的模型与参数、对声明式情景设定进行预防性验证，以及通过相应流程执行建模任务（原文摘要在此处截断）。作者特别强调，基于大语言模型的智能体虽然能为科学软件提供便捷的自然语言接口，但可靠性并不会自动得到保证，因此需要在框架层面内置校验与约束机制。这一工作为科学计算软件接入 AI 提供了“验证优先”的思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28692v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial Intelligence agents based on large language models provide convenient natural language interfaces to scientific software, but reliability is not automatic. Here we introduce the Epydemix Agent Framework, an additive layer over Epydemix, an open-source Python library for stochastic compartmental epidemic modeling. The framework extends the library with four capabilities to facilitate interaction with an AI agent: discovery of available models and parameters, preventive validation of a declarative scenario specification, execution throug…
items.why_zh: 它展示了让大语言模型安全驱动科学计算软件的一种范式：在扩展能力的同时把可靠性校验内置于框架之中。
items.why_en: It illustrates a pattern for letting LLMs safely drive scientific software by building reliability validation into the framework rather than assuming it.

items.title_zh: 面向小型搜索智能体的可验证奖励强化学习
items.title_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Small Search Agents
items.summary_zh: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）在数学、编程等奖励明确的问题上表现出色，但在奖励不那么清晰的场景是否同样有效仍是开放问题。“reason-over-search”这一配方把 RLVR 应用于开放域问答：由检索为答案提供依据，再通过与参考答案匹配来产生奖励信号。此前该配方主要在大模型上得到验证，在十亿参数以下的模型上仅能借助更大教师模型的蒸馏实现。本文直接在小模型（Qwen3.5……，原文摘要在此处截断）上测试该配方，检验小模型能否在不依赖蒸馏的情况下通过可验证奖励学会检索与推理。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28765v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) performs well on problems with clear rewards, such as mathematics and coding, but whether it also works where the reward is less clear remains open. The reason-over-search recipe applies RLVR to open-domain question answering, where retrieval grounds the answer and a match against the reference supplies the reward. So far it has been demonstrated on large models, and below one billion parameters only with distillation from a larger teacher. We test the recipe on a small model. We train Qwen3.5…
items.why_zh: 若成立，说明小模型也能靠可验证奖励自主学习检索式推理，而不必依赖大模型蒸馏。
items.why_en: If it holds, small models can learn retrieval-based reasoning from verifiable rewards without relying on distillation from larger teachers.

items.title_zh: 人机协同的假设检验：成本感知的 AI 选择性打分与人工逐级升级
items.title_en: Human-AI-Powered Hypothesis Testing: Cost-Aware Selective AI Scoring and Sequential Human Escalation
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型正越来越多地被当作廉价“裁判”，用于评估输出、标注数据，以及判断系统是否达到预期质量标准。但作者指出，把 AI 判断用于正式的统计推断，与简单把它当作真值标签有本质区别：AI 评估可能存在偏差或噪声，而严格的假设检验需要显式控制第一类错误与第二类错误。为此，研究探讨如何将 AI 判断与选择性的人工核验结合起来，在最低成本下完成一次有效的假设检验。其思路是按需选择性地对部分样本引入人工验证，并在必要时逐级升级到人工处理。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28859v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as inexpensive judges to evaluate outputs, label data, and assess whether a system meets a desired quality standard. Yet using AI judgments for formal statistical inference is fundamentally different from simply treating them as ground-truth labels: AI evaluations can be biased or noisy, and rigorous hypothesis testing requires explicit control of type-I and type-II errors. We study how to use AI judgments, together with selective human verification, to conduct a valid hypothesis test at minimum cost. W…
items.why_zh: 它回应了 AI 当“裁判”时的统计有效性问题，给出兼顾成本与错误率控制的可行方案。
items.why_en: It tackles the statistical validity of AI-as-judge, offering a way to control error rates while keeping costs low.

items.title_zh: Forecast-Dojo：可回放的 LLM 预测智能体评测与训练环境
items.title_en: Forecast-Dojo: Replayable Environments for Benchmarking and Training LLM Forecasting Agents
items.summary_zh: 研究者提出 Forecast-Dojo，一个可回放的环境，用于评测和训练大语言模型预测智能体。它把已经结算的预测市场问题与带有日期的新闻数据结合起来，让智能体研究某一事件，并在历史上连续的若干时间点反复给出预测。同一套任务与工具既支持重复评测，也支持收集训练交互，还能利用已记录的真实结果提供反馈，从而无需等待新事件结算。该环境包含 1,568 个 Polymarket 事件，按时间划分为训练期与评测期，并配有约 1880 万条（原文摘要在此处截断）相关数据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28876v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce Forecast-Dojo, a replayable environment for benchmarking and training LLM forecasting agents. It combines resolved prediction-market questions with dated news, allowing agents to research an event and revisit their predictions at successive historical dates. The same tasks and tools support repeated evaluation, collection of training interactions, and feedback from recorded outcomes without waiting for new events to resolve. Forecast-Dojo contains 1,568 Polymarket events, split by time into training and evaluation periods, and 18.8M…
items.why_zh: 可回放的历史环境让预测智能体的评测与训练不再受事件结算周期限制，可反复利用同一批数据。
items.why_en: A replayable historical setup frees forecasting-agent evaluation and training from event-resolution cycles, allowing the same data to be reused.

items.title_zh: PFArena：面向蛋白质改造的语言模型基准
items.title_en: PFArena: Benchmarking Language Models for Protein Modification
items.summary_zh: 蛋白质改造需要在极其庞大的序列空间中搜索，而湿实验验证通量低、成本高昂。尽管蛋白质语言模型（PLM）、大语言模型（LLM）以及基于 LLM 的智能体在该领域都展现出潜力，但在贴近真实实验决策的各种设定下，它们的相对效果仍不明确。为填补这一空白，作者提出 PFArena 基准，包含四个受控的任务接口，覆盖单突变体生成与多突变体排序两类核心问题。该基准意在为不同计算范式提供可比较的评测标准，帮助判断何种方法在现实蛋白质改造决策中更有效。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28921v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Protein modification requires navigating an immense sequence space, yet wet-lab validation remains low-throughput and costly. Although computational paradigms including protein language models (PLMs), large language models (LLMs), and LLM-based agents have shown promise in protein modification, their relative efficacy across realistic experimental decision-making settings remains unclear. To bridge this gap, we introduce PFArena, a benchmark comprising four controlled task interfaces that cover single-mutant generation and multi-mutant ranking. B…
items.why_zh: 它为蛋白质改造中的多种 AI 方法提供了统一、可控的对比评测，帮助判断哪种范式真正实用。
items.why_en: It offers a unified, controlled comparison of AI approaches for protein modification, clarifying which paradigm is actually useful.

items.title_zh: AlphaDiverse：面向多样探索的本地量化研究智能体后训练
items.title_en: AlphaDiverse: Post-Training Local Quantitative Research Agents for Diverse Exploration in Alpha Factor Mining
items.summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统可以自动挖掘 alpha 因子，但对外部 API 的依赖限制了成本控制、可用性与保密性。此外，长时间的研究循环往往反复回到少数成功过的经济机制，造成“研究路径坍缩”。为应对这些限制，作者提出 AlphaDiverse，一个整合三部分的框架：多智能体 alpha 研究系统、多样化研究路径收集，以及面向本地智能体的后训练。该框架让研究系统生成互补的方案组合，并通过对本地智能体后训练来提升探索的多样性，从而在无外部 API 依赖的前提下扩展搜索空间（原文摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29014v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems can automate alpha factor mining, but their reliance on external APIs limits control over cost, availability, and confidentiality. Long research loops also tend to revisit a few successful economic mechanisms that lead to research path collapse. To address these limitations, we propose AlphaDiverse, a framework that integrates a multi-agent alpha research system, diverse research path collection, and post-training for local agents. We let the research system generate complementary plan portfoli…
items.why_zh: 它试图让量化因子的自动挖掘摆脱外部 API 依赖，并缓解研究路径收敛导致的探索不足。
items.why_en: It aims to free automated alpha mining from external API dependence and counter the exploration collapse caused by path convergence.

items.title_zh: CRISS：辅助肿瘤登记员的检索增强 AI 聊天机器人
items.title_en: CRISS: A Retrieval-Augmented AI Chatbot for Assisting Cancer Registrars
items.summary_zh: 肿瘤登记员，包括肿瘤数据专员（ODS），必须解读复杂且频繁更新的编码与分期标准。为此，作者开发了 CRISS（Cancer Registry Intelligent Support System），一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）的对话式助手，旨在提供快速、带引用支撑的登记指南获取途径。本研究评估 CRISS 能否做到三点：一是给出准确且有引用支撑的回答；二是改善相关指南的可及性与解读效率；三是支持培训与服务台场景，同时保持（原文摘要在此处截断，涉及保密或合规方面的要求）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29075v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cancer registrars, including Oncology Data Specialists (ODSs), must interpret complex and frequently updated coding and staging standards. We developed CRISS (Cancer Registry Intelligent Support System), a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) conversational assistant that provides rapid, citation-supported access to registry guidance. This study evaluated whether CRISS could (1) support accurate and citation-supported responses, (2) improve access to and interpretation of relevant guidance, and (3) support training/helpdesk use while preserving h…
items.why_zh: 它展示了 RAG 助手在高度专业化、标准频繁更新的医疗登记场景中的落地价值与评估方式。
items.why_en: It demonstrates the value and evaluation of RAG assistants in a highly specialized medical registry domain with frequently updated standards.

items.title_zh: 在 WeBe Band 上快速训练与部署机器学习模型的流水线
items.title_en: A Rapid Pipeline for Training and Deploying ML Models on WeBe Band
items.summary_zh: 为算力与内存受限的边缘设备开发优化过的机器学习算法既困难又耗时，且高度依赖具体设备的约束条件。为此，作者简化了边缘机器学习工作流，使机器学习模型能够直接在 WeBe Band 上快速开发、优化与部署——WeBe Band 是一款用于多模态生理数据监测的手腕可穿戴设备。该系统可自动生成硬件高效的机器学习模型，并便于集成到目标设备中（原文摘要在此处截断）。这一流程意在降低设备特定约束带来的开发门槛，加速可穿戴场景下的模型落地。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29084v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Developing optimized machine-learning algorithms for edge devices with limited computational and memory resources is challenging, time-consuming, and highly dependent on device-specific constraints. In this work, we streamline an edge ML workflow to enable rapid development, optimization, and deployment of machine-learning (ML) models directly on the WeBe Band, a wrist-worn wearable device designed for multimodal physiological data monitoring. The proposed system automatically generates hardware-efficient ML models that can be easily integrated i…
items.why_zh: 它把设备约束纳入自动化流程，缩短了可穿戴健康设备上从模型到部署的周期。
items.why_en: By automating around device constraints, it shortens the path from model to deployment on wearable health devices.

items.title_zh: 先定范围再持久化：防止智能体记忆中的跨任务族干扰
items.title_en: Scope Before You Persist: Preventing Cross-Family Interference in Agent Memory
items.summary_zh: 持久记忆让语言模型智能体无需更新模型权重，就能改进提示与技能。该论文提出，只有当技能的检索范围与验证范围相匹配时，这些编辑才能在反复出现的任务族之间实现可靠的重复适配。研究在 ProcStream-RSI（一个 12 轮代码修复流）上考察冻结模型智能体，并使用以执行为判据的持久技能编辑门控方法 ORC（正交回归控制）。在一项固定候选方案与门控决策的干预实验中，只把每个已接受的技能检索用于其来源任务族，以检验跨任务族干扰的影响。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29144v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Persistent memory lets language-model agents improve prompts and skills without updating model weights. We show that matching retrieval scope to certification scope enables these edits to support reliable repeated adaptation across recurring task families. We study frozen-model agents on ProcStream-RSI, a 12-round code-repair stream, using Orthogonal Regression Control (ORC), an execution-grounded gate for persistent skill edits.
